scope: Conversation groups read deadline and optional summary degradation
Cache-only chats lookup and recommendation entry budget
integration_points: Existing route requestLogger conversations sys.warn plus operation.terminal HTTP root
Existing apiClient/onAttempt/onDispatch Faro/Sentry finite groups labels and entry-phase scheduling
failure_paths: Own groups deadline/known dependency timeout -> 503; unknown programming/permission errors remain errors
Summary deadline cancels transport; late failure observed without unhandled rejection or replacing primary result
Missing/invalid/expired/denied storage -> no full catalogue request; detail normal and viewer/session isolated
Entry vs manual recommendation budgets, 400 compatibility attempt shares controller, cancellation and stale response guards unchanged
logging_integration.correlation: Reuse release/platform/finite route and existing request timing; backend response headers retain request/trace identifiers. No extra DB lookups or user identifiers as labels.
logging_integration.redaction: Finite routes/stages only; never raw URL, query/hash, cookie, initData, token, user data, response content or payment URL. Backend safe {err} projection unchanged.
logging_integration.alerting: Reuse current default-off alerts, no new notifications; failure isolation and expected caller cancellation severity unchanged. Compare groups independently after release because historical detail included groups.
verification: Mocked Supabase RPC deadline and cause/unknown failure tests; Fastify inject summary/group contract assertions
Real QueryObserver/SSR cache/priority/TTL/viewer/session tests and existing frontend suites
